briefing.text: Nvidia has reportedly halted AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries.
PS5 consoles have sold out at major retailers in GTA VI's first Black Friday week.
The Hunger Games prequel reached $148 million in five days and leads Thanksgiving.
1Password says hackers took some customer names and emails, but not vault data.
42 state attorneys general are fighting Character.AI's plan to auction user data.

stories.title: PS5 sells out across major retailers in GTA VI's first Black Friday week
stories.summary: PS5 consoles have reportedly sold out at major US retailers, including Amazon and PlayStation Direct, less than a week after GTA VI's launch.
stories.why: Black Friday is the biggest console sales week, and a shortage leaves many holiday shoppers empty-handed.
stories.happened: Game Rant reports no official US Black Friday discounts on PS5. GamingBible says shortages reach the UK, Europe and Asia, with some sellers asking up to £1,475 for a PS5 Pro.
stories.next: Watch for restocks from Sony and major retailers before the holidays.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: GTA VI is driving people to buy consoles.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The shortage lands on the biggest shopping week of the year.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Resale prices are well above list price, reports say.

stories.background: The PS5 is Sony's current console, launched in 2020; the PS5 Pro followed in 2024.

meme.top: Black Friday arrived with big PS5 deals
meme.bottom: on consoles nobody can find
meme.take: Black Friday is here and the best PS5 deal is the one where you find one.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping heads into Thanksgiving with $148 million in five days
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel reached $148.2 million in North America by Tuesday and is expected to lead the holiday weekend.
stories.why: A strong debut would show book-based franchises can still fill cinemas in a crowded holiday season.
stories.happened: Gold Derby reports a $119.3 million opening weekend, then $12.8 million on Monday and $16 million on Tuesday, both franchise records. It has an A- CinemaScore and 94% on Rotten Tomatoes.
stories.next: Watch for the final five-day Thanksgiving totals and when it passes $200 million.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Its Monday and Tuesday takings set franchise records.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It had the fifth-biggest opening of the year.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Thanksgiving week is one of the busiest for cinemas.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: The Hunger Games won Thanksgiving
meme.bottom: nobody else even volunteered
meme.take: Sunrise on the Reaping is winning the holiday weekend, which suits a film about winning.

stories.title: Nvidia reportedly halts AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
stories.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to stop shipping AI servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, the FT reports.
stories.why: Southeast Asia has become a major hub for AI data centres, so a halt could ripple across the region's buildout.
stories.happened: The Financial Times, citing sources, says the move follows tighter US export controls. Bloomberg separately reports US chip curbs are stalling data centre loans tied to Chinese tech groups.
stories.next: Watch for confirmation from Nvidia and any response from the four governments.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Four countries with big data centre plans are affected.

drivers.label: Politics
drivers.text: It follows a tightening of US export controls.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Projects in the region depend on Nvidia hardware.

stories.background: Nvidia is the leading maker of the chips used to train and run AI models.

meme.top: Nvidia paused servers to four countries
meme.bottom: the data centres are now very quiet
meme.take: Nvidia reportedly paused shipments, so some data centres are now just centres.

stories.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to one million AI data centre satellites
stories.summary: The FCC approved SpaceX's proposed Starmind network of up to one million satellites for computing in low Earth orbit.
stories.why: Putting AI computing in orbit is one of the boldest answers yet to the shortage of power and space on the ground.
stories.happened: Reuters reports the FCC authorised a constellation of up to one million satellites for data centres in space. Scientists quoted by AP question whether the economics and cooling can work.
stories.next: Watch for SpaceX's launch timeline and any customers named for Starmind.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: One million satellites would dwarf every constellation flying today.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: AI firms are racing to find power and space for new data centres.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Scientists have raised doubts about cost and cooling in orbit.

stories.background: SpaceX is Elon Musk's rocket company and runs the Starlink satellite internet network.

meme.top: The FCC approved a million satellites
meme.bottom: for computers that rarely go outside
meme.take: Regulators approved a million data centres in orbit, which is one way to avoid local zoning.

stories.title: Sony says over 39 million PS5 players tried GTA VI in its first four days
stories.summary: Sony says more than 39 million unique PS5 players played GTA VI from November 19 to 22, setting a PlayStation concurrent-player record.
stories.why: The figures show how many people GTA VI pulled onto PS5 in its first weekend alone.
stories.happened: The PlayStation Blog says players logged 683 million hours, about 17.4 hours each. GTA VI was the first game played on 70% of newly connected PS5s, and Sony called it its biggest launch ever.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's own sales figures and Sony's holiday hardware numbers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 39 million players in four days on one console.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Sony called it the biggest launch in PlayStation history.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' best-selling series. Rockstar is owned by Take-Two Interactive.

meme.top: GTA VI players logged 683M hours
meme.bottom: Thanksgiving was a loading screen
meme.take: Players spent 683 million hours in GTA VI in four days, roughly the length of a family dinner.

stats.label: new PS5s that started with it

stories.title: 1Password says hackers took some customer data and source code
stories.summary: 1Password says an attacker used an employee's GitHub account to reach backend systems and took names and emails of some customers.
stories.why: Password managers hold people's most sensitive logins, so any breach at one gets close attention.
stories.happened: The Hacker News reports private source code was copied and CI/CD systems accessed. 1Password says vault contents, secrets and account recovery keys were not accessed, and affected users were notified.
stories.next: Watch for 1Password's full incident report and advice for affected users.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: A password manager is a high-value target.

drivers.label: Trust
drivers.text: 1Password says customer vaults were not accessed.

stories.background: 1Password is a popular password manager used by individuals and businesses.

meme.top: A password manager got breached
meme.bottom: the vaults, thankfully, held
meme.take: 1Password says the vaults held, which is the one job it really cannot fail.

stories.title: Pentagon officials reportedly discussed wartime law to return Huang to Nvidia
stories.summary: Pentagon officials discussed using the Defense Production Act to press Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang, the Washington Post reports.
stories.why: It raises questions about how far the government will go to shape the leadership of a key chip company.
stories.happened: The Washington Post cites sources for the report. Separately, Reuters reports the Justice Department did not open a formal probe into Huang before his reinstatement.
stories.next: Watch for the December 3 Senate hearing and any official response from the Pentagon.

drivers.label: Politics
drivers.text: Government pressure on a company's board is highly unusual.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is among the world's most valuable firms.

stories.background: The Defense Production Act is a 1950 US law that lets the government direct industry in the name of national defence.

meme.top: A wartime law was reportedly floated
meme.bottom: for a staffing question
meme.take: A wartime law was reportedly floated to settle who runs a chip company, a novel use of HR.

stories.title: 42 state attorneys general fight Character.AI's plan to auction user data
stories.summary: A group of 42 state attorneys general opposes Character.AI's plan to auction data from more than 21 million US accounts.
stories.why: Chats with AI companions can be deeply personal, so who gets to own them is a sensitive question.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports the data covers over 21 million US accounts, more than 2.1 million of them registered to minors. The attorneys general are pushing to stop the sale of users' chats.
stories.next: Watch for a court or regulator ruling on whether the sale can go ahead.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Over 21 million US accounts are said to be involved.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: More than 2.1 million accounts are registered to minors.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Selling private chat logs tests the limits of data rules.

stories.background: Character.AI is a chatbot app where people talk with AI characters, many of them created by other users.

meme.top: Character.AI planned to sell its chats
meme.bottom: 42 states asked to read the terms first
meme.take: A chatbot company tried to auction its conversations, and 42 states objected in writing.

stories.title: Focker-In-Law opens for Thanksgiving, with forecasts near $35 million
stories.summary: The fourth Meet the Parents film opened on Wednesday, with five-day forecasts between about $35 million and $45 million.
stories.why: It revives a big comedy franchise for the busiest family moviegoing week of the year.
stories.happened: JoBlo, citing Deadline, says the five-day gross is in the $35 million region, below Little Fockers' $45 million. Gold Derby predicts $45 million from more than 3,350 cinemas. It has a Metacritic score of 39.
stories.next: Watch for the final five-day numbers on Sunday.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The series began with Meet the Parents in 2000.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Ariana Grande joins the franchise.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opened on the busy Thanksgiving week.

stories.background: Meet the Parents is a comedy series about a nurse and his fearsome ex-CIA father-in-law.

meme.top: Focker-In-Law opened for Thanksgiving
meme.bottom: the reviews were like a family dinner
meme.take: Critics met the in-laws again this week and kept the conversation polite.

stories.title: Disney's $200 million Hexed is tracking for a soft Thanksgiving start
stories.summary: Disney's animated Hexed opened on Wednesday with five-day forecasts of about $31 million to $40 million against a reported cost above $200 million.
stories.why: Thanksgiving is one of the biggest moviegoing weeks of the year, and family films usually lead it.
stories.happened: Gold Derby says Hexed cost north of $200 million, took about $2 million in Tuesday previews and saw projections slip from $45 million over three weeks. JoBlo puts its five-day gross at about $31 million.
stories.next: Watch for the final weekend numbers and how it holds into December.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its reported budget is above $200 million.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces the Hunger Games prequel in its second week.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Thanksgiving week is a traditional window for Disney animation.

stories.background: Disney animation has often released films over Thanksgiving, including Frozen in 2013.

meme.top: Disney released a film called Hexed
meme.bottom: the box office took it personally
meme.take: Hexed opened to soft numbers, which is unfortunate branding in hindsight.

stories.title: EA uses AI to bring the late John Motson's voice to EA Sports FC 27
stories.summary: EA says it used AI and archive recordings to add the late commentator John Motson to EA Sports FC 27, with his family's permission.
stories.why: Recreating voices of people who have died is one of the most debated uses of AI in entertainment.
stories.happened: The BBC reports EA had permission from Motson's widow and son. Motson, who died in February 2023, commentated on FIFA games from FIFA 96 to FIFA 2005 and on FIFA 19.
stories.next: Watch for how players respond and whether other studios follow.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: AI recreations of real voices divide fans and performers.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Motson was a familiar voice in football games for years.

stories.background: John Motson was a long-serving BBC football commentator, known to many fans as Motty.

meme.top: EA rebuilt a commentator's voice
meme.bottom: and asked his family first
meme.take: EA used AI to bring back a much-loved commentator, and checked with his family first.

stories.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 designed proteins that bound to five targets in the lab
stories.summary: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models designed protein sequences using reasoning and code, and lab tests found binding to five targets.
stories.why: Drug discovery is one of the most valuable things AI could speed up, so lab-tested results draw attention.
stories.happened: OpenAI says the models worked out sequences through step-by-step reasoning and code rather than a specialised biology model. Lab experiments found evidence of binding to five targets.
stories.next: Watch for independent scientists testing or reproducing the designs.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A general model, not a biology tool, produced the designs.

drivers.label: Science
drivers.text: Results were checked in wet-lab experiments, OpenAI says.

stories.background: OpenAI makes ChatGPT and the GPT series of AI models.

meme.top: GPT-6 designed working proteins
meme.bottom: biology departments asked for its CV
meme.take: OpenAI says GPT-6 designs proteins now, so the lab coat is next.

stories.title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies at 65
stories.summary: Andy Taylor, the guitarist of Duran Duran, has died at 65 after a long battle with prostate cancer, JoBlo reports.
stories.why: Duran Duran were one of the defining bands of the 1980s, and fans around the world are paying tribute.
stories.happened: JoBlo reports Taylor died after a long illness with prostate cancer. He was a member of Duran Duran during the band's 1980s success.
stories.next: Watch for tributes from his bandmates and fellow musicians.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Duran Duran sold millions of records in the 1980s.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The band's early hits remain widely played.

stories.background: Duran Duran formed in Birmingham, England, in 1978 and became one of the biggest bands of the MTV era.

meme.top: Andy Taylor, Duran Duran guitarist
meme.bottom: has died at 65
meme.take: Andy Taylor, guitarist for Duran Duran, has died at 65.

stories.title: FinCEN takes systems offline after unauthorised access
stories.summary: The US Treasury's financial crimes unit says it is investigating unauthorised access to a limited subset of its systems.
stories.why: It is the latest in a string of reported breaches at US federal agencies this month.
stories.happened: Help Net Security reports FinCEN took some systems offline and has not said who was behind it. A FinCEN order lets filers hit by the disruption submit filings due November 18 to December 29 until December 30.
stories.next: Watch for FinCEN to say which systems were accessed and when they come back.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: FinCEN holds sensitive financial reports.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Several US agencies have reported breaches recently.

stories.background: FinCEN is the US Treasury bureau that collects reports used to fight money laundering.

meme.top: The money laundering watchdog
meme.bottom: is now filing its own incident report
meme.take: FinCEN took systems offline, and filers have been given an extension, which is rare good news.

stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed to Saturday over bad weather
stories.summary: NBC's broadcast of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been moved to Saturday because of bad weather, TVLine reports.
stories.why: The parade is a century-old Thanksgiving ritual for millions of viewers, so a delay is rare news.
stories.happened: TVLine says the parade was postponed until Saturday because of weather. NBC broadcasts the parade each Thanksgiving morning.
stories.next: Watch for the new broadcast time and any changes to the balloon line-up.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It is one of the most watched broadcasts of the holiday.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Postponing the parade is very unusual.

stories.background: The Macy's parade has run in New York since 1924 and is known for its giant character balloons.

meme.top: The Thanksgiving parade was postponed
meme.bottom: the turkey did not get that option
meme.take: Macy's moved the parade to Saturday, the only thing this week not stuffed into Thursday.

stories.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in its first four days
stories.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 44.9 million units and grossed over $4 billion by the end of its launch weekend.
stories.why: GTA VI is the most anticipated game in years, and its sales are a benchmark for the whole industry.
stories.happened: The figures are a third-party estimate reported by The Fly; Take-Two has not confirmed them. The game launched on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at $79.99, with no PC date yet.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's own sales figures and any PC release date.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Tens of millions of copies in days is close to unheard of.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The game sells at $79.99, above the usual price.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' best-selling series; GTA V came out in 2013. Rockstar is owned by Take-Two.

meme.top: Analysts counted 44.9 million copies
meme.bottom: Rockstar is still counting the money
meme.take: GTA VI's estimated sales are now large enough to need their own map.

stories.title: CBS says Nvidia sold top chips to two Chinese-owned California firms
stories.summary: A CBS News investigation says Nvidia sold some of its most advanced chips to two Chinese-owned California companies.
stories.why: It adds to questions over whether US limits on AI chips reaching China are working.
stories.happened: CBS reports the two firms leased or sold some of the chips to companies in Asia. The Washington Post separately found restricted Nvidia servers on offer in Shenzhen.
stories.next: Watch for any response from Nvidia or US regulators.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: It questions how well export controls work.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The reports involve Nvidia's most advanced chips.

stories.background: US rules restrict sales of the most powerful AI chips to China over national security concerns.

meme.top: The export ban had one weak spot
meme.bottom: California, apparently
meme.take: Nvidia's top chips reportedly reached China by way of California. Geography is flexible now.

stories.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to let Meta's Muse agent shop on Amazon
stories.summary: Amazon and Meta are said to be negotiating an end to Amazon's September block on Meta's Muse shopping agent.
stories.why: Whether AI agents can shop on Amazon decides who controls online shopping in the agent era.
stories.happened: Fortune reports the companies are discussing a deal to connect Muse to Amazon and that it would need sign-off from both CEOs. The Decoder says ad revenue and search control are part of the talks. No deal has been announced.
stories.next: Watch for whether a deal is announced and what Amazon gets in return.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Amazon's ad business is reported at $68.6 billion a year.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Two giants are fighting over who owns the shopper.

stories.background: Muse is Meta's AI assistant, which can also act as a shopping agent.

meme.top: Meta's AI wants to shop at Amazon
meme.bottom: Amazon wants to know who is paying
meme.take: Two of the largest tech firms are negotiating whether a robot can go shopping.

stories.title: Dario Amodei calls claims he would hand decisions to AI absurd
stories.summary: Anthropic's CEO rejected reporting that suggested he would cede human control to AI, and challenged Axios's account.
stories.why: How much control AI companies plan to give their own systems is one of the biggest questions in the field.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports Amodei called the accusations absurd and disputed an Axios report. He also criticised positions taken by rival executives as driven by impressions rather than substance.
stories.next: Watch for Axios's response and any follow-up from Anthropic on how it keeps humans in charge.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amodei leads one of the top AI labs.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: He publicly disputed a news outlet's reporting.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Anthropic has just begun trading as a public company.

stories.background: Dario Amodei co-founded Anthropic, the company behind the Claude models, after working at OpenAI.

meme.top: An AI lab had to confirm
meme.bottom: the humans are still holding the keys
meme.take: An AI company had to say on the record that people still make the decisions. Noted.

stories.title: Avengers: Doomsday is tracking for an opening above $270 million
stories.summary: Early tracking points to a US opening of more than $270 million for Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday, JoBlo reports.
stories.why: An Avengers film is Hollywood's surest bet, and a huge opening would cap a strong year for cinemas.
stories.happened: JoBlo reports tracking above $270 million for Avengers: Doomsday. It also lists Dune: Part Three tracking at $75 million or more. Both are projections, not results.
stories.next: Watch for updated tracking and presale records as release approaches.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The Avengers films are among the biggest ever made.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Tracking points to one of the year's largest openings.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Dune: Part Three opens in the same busy December stretch.

stories.background: Avengers: Doomsday is the next team-up film in Marvel Studios' long-running cinematic universe, owned by Disney.

meme.top: Avengers tracking at $270 million
meme.bottom: the multiverse has a marketing budget
meme.take: Avengers: Doomsday is tracking above $270 million, so doom is doing fine commercially.

stories.title: Microsoft says state hackers have adopted the ARTEX AI hacking tool
stories.summary: Microsoft says state-backed groups from China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, now use the AI penetration-testing tool ARTEX.
stories.why: AI tools that automate parts of hacking could make attacks faster and cheaper for many more groups.
stories.happened: The Record reports ARTEX automates stages of an intrusion using existing penetration-testing tools. Microsoft says criminal groups use it too.
stories.next: Watch for guidance from Microsoft on how to detect ARTEX activity.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: AI is lowering the effort needed for attacks.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Security firms report more AI-assisted intrusions.

stories.background: Salt Typhoon is a China-linked hacking group known for breaching telecom networks.

meme.top: Hackers adopted an AI assistant
meme.bottom: it also handles the boring parts
meme.take: State hackers are now using AI tools, proving every job is getting automated.

stories.title: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and the shares jump about 30%
stories.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23 to bring back Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, days after his resignation.
stories.why: Nvidia is the most important supplier of AI chips, so who runs it moves markets and politics.
stories.happened: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to bring Huang back, and shares rose about 31%, reports say. CNBC reported he told staff Nvidia does not need a traditional succession plan.
stories.next: Watch for the December 3 Senate hearing and the board's independent investigation.

drivers.label: U-turn
drivers.text: The board had ruled out his return only days earlier.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Reports put the one-day share gain near 30%, its biggest since 2003.

drivers.label: Politics
drivers.text: Lawmakers from both parties have criticised the decision.

stories.background: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and ran it for over three decades as it became the leading maker of AI chips.

meme.top: Nvidia's CEO is back at work
meme.bottom: the succession plan is him
meme.take: Nvidia's succession plan has been finalised, and it is the same man.

stories.title: OpenAI preprint claims the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4
stories.summary: OpenAI posted a maths preprint claiming the exponent of matrix multiplication is 9/4, a result not yet independently checked.
stories.why: Faster matrix multiplication is a famous open problem, and AI labs now compete to claim maths results.
stories.happened: The paper appeared in OpenAI's public maths repository on November 24. Roundups stress it has not been independently validated. It follows other AI-assisted maths claims this month.
stories.next: Watch for mathematicians reviewing the proof and whether it holds up.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AI labs are trading big maths claims this month.

drivers.label: Big claim
drivers.text: The exponent has been an open question for decades.

stories.background: Matrix multiplication underpins much of computing, including the training of AI models.

meme.top: OpenAI says the answer is 9/4
meme.bottom: reviewers say show your working
meme.take: An AI lab says it settled an old maths problem, pending the small matter of checking.

stories.title: ElevenLabs reportedly in early talks to raise at a $33 billion valuation
stories.summary: Voice AI firm ElevenLabs is said to be in early talks for a 2027 funding round at a $33 billion target valuation.
stories.why: Investors are still paying up for AI firms with fast-growing revenue, even as the wider AI trade wobbles.
stories.happened: Bloomberg reports the target is up from $22 billion in September, citing people familiar. It says annual recurring revenue now stands at $700 million. Talks are early and no round is confirmed.
stories.next: Watch for whether the round is confirmed and who leads it.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The target is up $11 billion since September, reportedly.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Voice is one of the fastest-growing uses of AI.

stories.background: ElevenLabs makes AI voice tools used for narration, dubbing and voice agents.

meme.top: ElevenLabs may be worth $33 billion
meme.bottom: the voice of money speaks clearly
meme.take: A company that clones voices is said to be worth $33 billion, and it is not even singing.

stories.title: Team Cherry hosts Cherry Time! with Silksong news and a free DLC
stories.summary: Team Cherry streams a Cherry Time! event on November 27 with Hollow Knight: Silksong announcements, including the free Sea of Sorrow DLC.
stories.why: Silksong has one of the most devoted fan bases in gaming, and free content is a big draw.
stories.happened: Instant Gaming reports the YouTube event starts at 5pm GMT on November 27. Several Silksong announcements are promised, among them the free Sea of Sorrow DLC.
stories.next: Watch for a release date for Sea of Sorrow during the stream.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Silksong fans waited years for the game itself.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The event lands on Black Friday, a busy day for games news.

stories.background: Team Cherry is the small Australian studio behind Hollow Knight. Silksong, its sequel, launched in September 2025.

meme.top: Silksong fans waited years for the game
meme.bottom: the DLC wait is mercifully shorter
meme.take: Team Cherry streams today, and Silksong fans are ready to wait, which they are good at.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude agents moved its API from Python to Rust
stories.summary: Anthropic reports that Claude agents migrated its Messages API to Rust, cutting processor use per request by about 70%.
stories.why: It is a large, real engineering job done mostly by AI, with measured results.
stories.happened: Agents compared the old and new versions against live requests, and engineers reviewed the fixes. Anthropic reports about 70% less processor use per request and a 20% shorter median time to first token.
stories.next: Watch for other companies trying AI-led rewrites of production systems.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The Messages API is the core service behind Claude.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding agents are moving from small fixes to whole systems.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company that makes the Claude models.

meme.top: Claude rewrote its own API in Rust
meme.bottom: and now it will not stop mentioning it
meme.take: Claude rewrote its own plumbing in Rust, the most developer thing an AI has done yet.

stories.title: US chip curbs stall billions in Asian data centre loans
stories.summary: Lenders are holding back data centre financing tied to ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent after new US chip curbs, Bloomberg reports.
stories.why: Data centres in Asia run on loans and Nvidia chips, so tighter rules can freeze projects quickly.
stories.happened: Bloomberg, citing sources, says some lenders are delaying a $6.6 billion loan for Bridge Data Centres. It also reports Asian operators are courting US clients as rental prices for B300 chips fall.
stories.next: Watch for whether the loans are restructured or cancelled.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A single delayed loan is $6.6 billion.

drivers.label: Politics
drivers.text: The pause follows new US export rules.

stories.background: ByteDance owns TikTok; Alibaba and Tencent are two of China's largest tech companies.

meme.top: Asian data centres had chips and plans
meme.bottom: now they have one of those
meme.take: Lenders paused billions for data centres, which are now centres of mostly paperwork.

stories.title: ChatGPT merges Chat and Work limits, so heavy users may hit caps sooner
stories.summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT's Chat and Work modes will share one usage allowance, so people who use both heavily may hit limits sooner.
stories.why: Usage limits decide how much paying subscribers actually get for their money.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports the merged Chat and Work tabs, with one shared usage meter, are rolling out to a small group of Pro users first. Instant stays available after the allowance runs out, and a wider rollout is planned for December.
stories.next: Watch for the December rollout and how paid plans' limits change.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It changes what paid subscribers get.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Heavy users are the most vocal ChatGPT audience.

stories.background: ChatGPT is OpenAI's chatbot and one of the most used AI apps in the world.

meme.top: ChatGPT merged work and play
meme.bottom: like most of us did years ago
meme.take: ChatGPT now counts work and chat as one allowance, which is how weekends feel.

stories.title: Rockstar UK staff vote 75% against union recognition
stories.summary: Staff at Rockstar's UK studios voted against union recognition sought with the IWGB union, with 75% voting no.
stories.why: Unionisation is a growing debate in games, and Rockstar is the industry's most watched studio this month.
stories.happened: Instant Gaming reports some UK employees, represented by the IWGB, had sought recognition. In the vote, 75% of employees voted against it.
stories.next: Watch for the union's next steps and any statement from Rockstar.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The vote came in GTA VI's launch week.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Union drives are spreading across game studios.

stories.background: Rockstar Games has several UK studios, including Rockstar North in Edinburgh, which leads GTA development.

meme.top: Rockstar staff had one vote this week
meme.bottom: and it was not for game of the year
meme.take: Rockstar UK held a union vote in launch week, when the office already had enough going on.

stories.title: CD Projekt says The Witcher 4 stays multiplatform despite its Sony deal
stories.summary: After signing a marketing deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, CD Projekt says its games, including The Witcher 4, will stay multiplatform.
stories.why: Marketing deals shape where big games are shown first, and The Witcher 4 is one of the most awaited RPGs.
stories.happened: The marketing deal with PlayStation was announced earlier in the week. CD Projekt then said The Witcher 4 and its other games will remain multiplatform, Instant Gaming reports. No release date has been given.
stories.next: Watch for a release window and what the Sony deal means for PlayStation players.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The Witcher 3 is one of the best-selling RPGs ever.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Marketing deals are a long-running PlayStation and Xbox battleground.

stories.background: CD Projekt Red is the Polish studio behind The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077.

meme.top: CD Projekt signed a deal with Sony
meme.bottom: then reassured everyone else
meme.take: CD Projekt signed with Sony and promptly told the other platforms it still loves them.

stories.title: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages up to 14 days ahead
stories.summary: WhatsApp users can now schedule messages from 10 minutes to 14 days in advance in both group and individual chats.
stories.why: WhatsApp has billions of users, so even a small feature changes how a lot of people message.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports scheduled messages send even if the phone is switched off. The feature works in individual and group chats.
stories.next: Watch for the rollout to reach all users and regions.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: WhatsApp is one of the world's most used apps.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Scheduling has long been a requested feature.

stories.background: WhatsApp is the messaging app owned by Meta.

meme.top: WhatsApp lets you schedule messages
meme.bottom: so you can be thoughtful in advance
meme.take: WhatsApp now schedules messages, so your birthday wishes can be sincere and automated.

stories.title: New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years
stories.summary: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law banning the manufacture and sale of AI chatbot-powered toys in New York for five years.
stories.why: It is one of the first laws to take AI chatbots out of a whole product category for children.
stories.happened: NBC News reports the ban covers making and selling toys powered by AI chatbots, lasts five years and starts in February. California signed a four-year ban in September.
stories.next: Watch for toy makers' responses and whether other states follow.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Few places have banned a whole category of AI products.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands at the start of holiday toy shopping.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Child safety is a growing focus of AI rules.

stories.background: New York is one of the biggest US states and often an early mover on tech rules.

meme.top: New York banned toys that chat
meme.bottom: the teddy bear may remain silent
meme.take: New York banned talking AI toys, restoring the classic toy that just stares at you.

stories.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
stories.summary: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.
stories.why: Netflix rarely puts its films in big-screen cinemas, so a run like this draws attention.
stories.happened: Gold Derby says the film is on 250 IMAX screens, with 82% on Rotten Tomatoes. JoBlo notes Netflix often does not report grosses, so no box office figure was published.
stories.next: Watch for its IMAX box office over the holiday weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opens on the busiest moviegoing week of autumn.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Netflix theatrical runs in IMAX are unusual.

stories.background: Cliff Booth was Brad Pitt's stuntman character in the 2019 film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.

meme.top: Netflix put a film in cinemas
meme.bottom: then declined to say how it did
meme.take: Netflix's Cliff Booth is in IMAX, and its box office is a secret even to the box office.

stories.title: Ubisoft developers may have to justify not using AI, report says
stories.summary: Ubisoft may require its developers to explain decisions not to use generative AI, according to Vertical Slice.
stories.why: Studios are split on generative AI, and a mandate like this would be one of the strongest pushes yet.
stories.happened: Chris Kerr of Vertical Slice reports the policy, as summarised by Instant Gaming. The report notes Ubisoft already uses generative AI widely. Ubisoft has not confirmed the details.
stories.next: Watch for a response from Ubisoft or its developers.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Generative AI in games is divisive among players and developers.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Big publishers are leaning further into AI tools.

stories.background: Ubisoft is the French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry.

meme.top: At Ubisoft, doing it by hand
meme.bottom: may soon need a written excuse
meme.take: Ubisoft staff may need a reason to work without AI, which is a reason in itself.

stories.title: Neuralink says the FDA approved a pivotal trial of its brain implant
stories.summary: Neuralink says it received FDA approval for its LINK Pivotal Study, a US trial of its brain-computer interface in people with ALS.
stories.why: A pivotal trial is a key step towards a brain implant being approved for wider medical use.
stories.happened: Bloomberg reports the study will test the device in ALS patients in the US. Pivotal trials are the larger studies regulators use to decide on approval.
stories.next: Watch for when the trial starts enrolling and how many patients it includes.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Few brain implants have reached this stage.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Neuralink was co-founded by Elon Musk.

stories.background: Neuralink develops implants that let people control computers with their thoughts.

meme.top: Neuralink reached a pivotal trial
meme.bottom: now the slides have to become data
meme.take: Neuralink's implant heads to a pivotal trial, where confidence meets a control group.

stories.title: The Hunting Wives returns to Netflix with an eight-episode second season
stories.summary: Netflix released all eight episodes of The Hunting Wives' second season on Thanksgiving, TVLine reports.
stories.why: Holiday weekends are prime binge time, and a returning drama gives Netflix a fresh weekend draw.
stories.happened: TVLine says the season dropped at 3am ET on November 26. The story picks up with Sophie and Margo estranged before events push them back together.
stories.next: Watch for whether it enters Netflix's weekly top 10 chart.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It landed on a long holiday weekend.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Returning seasons usually arrive with a built-in audience.

stories.background: The Hunting Wives is a drama series about a woman drawn into a circle of wealthy, secretive friends.

meme.top: Netflix released a whole season
meme.bottom: for the people avoiding their relatives
meme.take: The Hunting Wives dropped on Thanksgiving: eight hours of somebody else's family drama.

stories.title: US PS5 sales more than doubled year on year in the week before GTA VI
stories.summary: Circana data shows US PS5 hardware sales in the week ending November 14 were over 2.4 times the same week of 2025.
stories.why: It shows GTA VI lifting console sales even before it came out.
stories.happened: Circana's Mat Piscatella says Xbox Series X|S sales were also more than 2.3 times year-ago levels that week. The week came before GTA VI's November 19 launch.
stories.next: Watch for Circana's November figures covering launch week and Black Friday.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Sales more than doubled versus last year.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Buyers stocked up ahead of GTA VI.

stories.background: Circana is the market research firm that tracks US video game sales.

meme.top: Console sales doubled before GTA VI
meme.bottom: people were buying a car for the drive
meme.take: PS5 sales more than doubled before GTA VI came out, which explains this week's empty shelves.

stats.label: US PS5 sales vs last year
Xbox Series sales vs last year

stories.title: Nvidia agrees to pay $290 million to settle a 2018 crypto investor lawsuit
stories.summary: Nvidia will pay $290 million to settle a 2018 class action claiming it misled shareholders about crypto mining demand for its GPUs.
stories.why: It closes a long-running case over how much of Nvidia's earlier growth came from crypto miners.
stories.happened: Reuters reports the investors alleged Nvidia understated how much crypto mining drove its graphics card sales. The case dates back to 2018.
stories.next: Watch for the court's review of the settlement.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The settlement is $290 million.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands in an already turbulent week for Nvidia.

stories.background: Nvidia's graphics cards were popular with cryptocurrency miners before its AI chip boom.

meme.top: Nvidia settled its crypto-era lawsuit
meme.bottom: for about one rounding error
meme.take: Nvidia paid $290 million to close a 2018 case, which counts as a quiet week there.

stories.title: King Crimson's original drummer Michael Giles dies at 84
stories.summary: Michael Giles, the founding drummer of King Crimson, has died at 84, according to a report credited to Variety.
stories.why: King Crimson shaped progressive rock, and Giles played on its landmark first album.
stories.happened: The death was reported by Variety and carried in MusicNewsletter's daily brief. Giles was King Crimson's drummer at its formation in 1969.
stories.next: Watch for tributes from musicians and former bandmates.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: King Crimson's debut is a classic of 1960s rock.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The band influenced generations of progressive musicians.

stories.background: King Crimson's 1969 debut, In the Court of the Crimson King, is often credited with launching progressive rock.

meme.top: Michael Giles, King Crimson drummer
meme.bottom: has died at 84
meme.take: Michael Giles, King Crimson's original drummer, has died at 84.

stories.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie comes to Netflix on November 30
stories.summary: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie joins Netflix's US library on November 30 after its Peacock run, Collider reports.
stories.why: It was the year's first billion-dollar film, so its streaming debut is a big holiday draw.
stories.happened: Collider says the film was the first 2026 release to pass $1 billion at the box office, short of the $1.3 billion of the 2023 original. A further sequel is said not to be expected before 2029.
stories.next: Watch for whether it tops Netflix's film chart in its first week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Mario is Nintendo's most famous character.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It passed $1 billion at the box office.

stories.background: The Super Mario Bros. Movie from Illumination and Nintendo was one of 2023's biggest hits.

meme.top: A billion-dollar film reaches Netflix
meme.bottom: Mario has seen tougher pipes
meme.take: A billion-dollar Mario film lands on Netflix, the couch finally beating the cinema.

stories.title: PS Plus adds Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 and two more games in December
stories.summary: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 and Amnesia: The Bunker join PlayStation Plus from December 1.
stories.why: PS Plus monthly games are a key perk for millions of subscribers, especially for new console owners.
stories.happened: Instant Gaming reports the three games arrive for Essential, Extra and Premium members on December 1. Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 comes in its cross-gen edition.
stories.next: Watch for December's Extra and Premium catalogue additions.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater is a classic series.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Many new PS5 owners arrive over the holidays.

stories.background: PlayStation Plus is Sony's subscription service for online play and monthly games.

meme.top: PS Plus is giving away Tony Hawk
meme.bottom: to people who could not find a PS5
meme.take: December's PS Plus games are ready, for anyone who managed to buy the console.

stories.title: Ant Group releases Ling-3.2-air, an MIT-licensed multimodal model
stories.summary: Ant Group released Ling-3.2-air, a model that handles text, images and video, with open weights under the MIT licence.
stories.why: Chinese labs keep releasing capable open models that anyone can download and build on.
stories.happened: TechNode reports the model's weights are MIT-licensed. Ant says it completed 61% of tasks on its own office-work test, up from 15.7% for Ling-3.0-flash-VL.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Open-weight releases from China keep coming.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The company reports a big jump on its own office-task test.

stories.background: Ant Group is the Chinese fintech company behind the Alipay payments app.

meme.top: A payments company built an AI model
meme.bottom: because why not, everyone else did
meme.take: Ant Group released an open AI model, joining the club of companies that are now AI companies.
